# UGC Flows

> UGC Flows (ugcflows.com) is a $500 a month membership for UGC creators. It places members in brand deals paying $750 or more, runs 8 group coaching calls a month, hosts a community of 30 working creators, assigns editors, builds each creator's portfolio, and gives them one app that tracks every deal, every payment and every post across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook. The guarantee: land a brand deal in your first 30 days or the $500 is refunded in full.

## Who it is for

- Creators already doing UGC brand deals who want better paying ones and less admin.
- Creators already paying for a UGC mentorship, coaching program or course who want the same calls and community plus a guaranteed placed deal.
- Mentorships and coaching programs that want to white label the platform for their students.

## Key facts

- Price: $500 per month, no setup fee, billed monthly.
- First placed deal: pays $750 or more, rate agreed up front and in writing.
- Guarantee: if the first 30 days have not landed a deal or earned the $500 back, the $500 is refunded in full. Conditions: finish onboarding, take the deals placed, deliver on brief, email within 7 days of day 30.
- Included: brand deals placed for you, 8 coaching calls a month (2 a week), the creator community and deal room, editors, a UGC portfolio built for you, and the app for deals, money and posting.
- First group is capped at 30 creators.
- Contact: hello@ugcflows.com

- [Home](https://www.ugcflows.com/): the creator offer, price, guarantee, reviews and FAQ.

- [For mentorships](https://www.ugcflows.com/mentorships): white label the platform under your own brand. $500 once per student, then $125 a month per graduate who stays.
- [Editors](https://www.ugcflows.com/editors): video editing work for editors who cut UGC.
